QuestInfo.name: Helios Tower Library
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1401002##k uncovered some new leads for you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1401002# pointed you toward the #b#m220000000# Helios Tower <Library>#k, the place with the most books in the world. If there are no records there, it's a strong possibility that someone is systematically destroying evidence of the heroes.

0.0: Captain! I'm glad you're back safe. I've been working sooo hard on this hero record thing and it's super fishy! There should be something left over after a war, even if they were burning every book in sight.
0.1: I think you should go to #b#m222020000##k. Every piece of text in Maple World is supposed to be stored there. If they don't have any books on your heroes, we can know for sure that somebody's been tampering!

yes.0: Ask #b#p2040052##k in #m222020000# to find you records of the heroes.

no.0: Do you hate libraries, captain? I bet you never read, even though you act like you're so smart! Hehehe.

1.0: Welcome to #m222020000#. You must be looking for... books on the heroes who first battled the Black Mage hundreds of years ago. Don't look so surprised that I knew that, I am a very good librarian.

npc.0: Still waiting on that trip to #b#m222020000##k, captain? Don't worry, the books won't bite!
